title: Terms and Disclaimer
content:
Terms and Conditions

These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the services provided by Samok Arya Bhavan ("we," "us," or "our"). By accessing or using our website, services, or visiting our restaurants, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms.

1. General Information

1.1 Company Details:
Asgard Ventures LTD (company no. 09828018 trading as Samok Arya Bhavan).

1.2 These Terms apply to your use of our website (https://www.skaryabhavan.com) and your interactions with us, including reservations, orders, or any other services we offer.

2. Reservations

2.1 Reservations are subject to availability and confirmation.

2.2 A deposit may be required for large bookings or special events. Failure to attend or cancel within the required notice period may result in the forfeiture of your deposit.

2.3 We reserve the right to cancel or modify your reservation in unforeseen circumstances.

3. Payment

3.1 Payments for services and products are accepted in GBP (£) via cash, credit card, or debit card.

3.2 For online purchases or vouchers, payment must be completed during checkout.

3.3 Refunds will only be issued in accordance with our Refund Policy (refer to section 5).

4. Refund Policy

4.1 Refunds for online purchases or reservations will be processed in accordance with our policies.

4.2 Refunds may take up to 14 business days to appear in your account, depending on your payment provider.

4.3 Refunds will not be provided for no-shows or late cancellations, unless in exceptional circumstances approved by management.

5. Use of Our Website

5.1 You agree to use our website only for lawful purposes and in a manner that does not infringe the rights of, or restrict or inhibit the use and enjoyment of, the website by any third party.

5.2 We do not guarantee that the website will be free from viruses or other malicious software. You are responsible for ensuring that your device is protected.

5.3 We may occasionally restrict access to certain parts of our website for maintenance or updates.

Food Images Disclaimer

Images of food displayed on our website, menus, or promotional materials are for illustrative purposes only. Actual dishes may vary in appearance, portion size, and presentation due to factors such as ingredient availability, preparation methods, and seasonal variations.

6. Privacy and Data Protection

6.1 Your personal information will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy, which is available at https://skaryabhavan.com/cookie-policy-uk/

6. Liability

6.1 While we aim to provide the best experience, we are not liable for:

  • Any interruptions to our services due to unforeseen circumstances.
  • Losses or damages incurred while using our services or website unless directly caused by our negligence.

6.2 We are not responsible for any personal belongings left at our premises.

7. Promotions and Discounts

7.1 Promotions, discounts, or vouchers are subject to specific terms and conditions outlined in the respective offer.

7.2 Promotions cannot be combined with other offers unless explicitly stated.

8. Complaints

8.1 We value your feedback. If you have any complaints, please contact us directly via Contact@skaryabhavan.com
8.2 We will aim to respond to your complaint within 7 business days.

9. Governing Law

9.1 These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales.

9.2 Any disputes arising under these Terms will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.

10. Changes to These Terms

10.1 We reserve the right to update or modify these Terms at any time without prior notice.

10.2 The latest version of these Terms will always be available on our website at https://skaryabhavan.com/terms-and-disclaimer/

Contact Us

If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at:

Email: Contact@skaryabhavan.com
